title: End-of-term cake for a Riverstone or Tallawong class? 100% eggless
summary:
Thank-you cake for a teacher in Riverstone or Tallawong? Every cake we make is 100% eggless, so nobody in the staffroom has to ask.

No checking which kids are vegetarian. No asking who avoids egg. Not in the sponge, not in the buttercream, not in any of the 15 flavours.

A 6-inch serves 6-8 and starts at $39.99, which covers a staffroom morning tea. A 10-inch serves 20-22, which covers the class party in the last week of Term 4.

Order 2 days ahead and pick up from Riverstone Shopping Centre, with free parking in the centre car park. Tell us the teacher's name and we pipe it on. 🎂

The card is optional. The cake is not.
